notes.title: Hotfix 21.02.24
notes.content:
21.02.24

# Changed

Red Button mashing can now also be done by letter keys - bring your productivity faking skills to a whole new level by pretending to type on your keyboard

“F” key no longer toggles fullscreen (ALT+Enter still works)
